tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The account's balance: perp equity, free margin (available), margin in use, spot USDC, per extra dex.

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: Open perpetual positions: side, size, entry, value, unrealized PnL, leverage, liquidation price.

tools.name: get_open_orders
tools.description: Resting orders (limits and TP/SL triggers) with their order ids.

tools.name: get_markets
tools.description: Tradable markets with their mid price and maximum leverage. Main Hyperliquid dex by default; pass dex (e.g. xyz) for a builder dex.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Current mid, mark and oracle price, funding and 24h volume for one market.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place a REAL order. Market orders are priced by WenLong from its own mark with a small slippage buffer. leverage (integer) is applied to the market before an opening order; omitted, the open position's leverage is used (required when there is no position). take_profit / stop_loss: on a limit order t

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel one resting order by its order id (see get_open_orders).

tools.name: close_position
tools.description: Close an open position at market (reduce-only). fraction in (0, 1], default 1 = the whole position.
